player.name: Jalen Brunson
player.physicalDescription: 6'2" point guard with a strong, compact build, short dark hair, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, calm unwavering focus in his eyes. LEFT-HANDED SHOOTER. MIRROR CHECK: he faces the viewer, so the raised arm holding the basketball must appear on the RIGHT HALF of the picture; the bronze bracer is on the lowered arm on the LEFT half of the picture
player.archetype: The overlooked general who finally led the city across

fusion.wardrobe: a short commander's cloak of deep crimson with a gold border clasped at one shoulder and streaming behind him, a bronze-studded leather war belt over the blank shorts, and a bronze bracer on his non-shooting (right) forearm
fusion.accents: a curled ram's-horn shofar slung across his back on a leather cord
fusion.aura: a general's calm in the chaos - completely unafraid, as if the clock has stopped just for him
fusion.background: the op-art rings are SOUND WAVES blasting from seven curled ram's horns spaced around the card's border; behind him, massive ancient stone city walls crumbling and falling outward in the shockwave; a tiny scarlet cord hanging from one high window in the crumbling wall; a blazing sun frozen in the sky on the left and a pale moon frozen on the right, both perfectly still; at his feet, twelve smooth river stones stacked as a small memorial cairn; along the bottom edge, river water standing up in two tall glassy walls on either side, as if the river has stopped flowing

figure.name: Joshua
figure.attributeDescription: the curled ram's horns whose blast brought down the walls of Jericho
figure.clothing: bronze and leather armor over a woven tunic, commander's cloak
figure.physicalDescription: seasoned warrior-leader, short dark beard, steady fearless eyes
figure.archetype: The successor who finally led the people across the Jordan

connection.thematic: Moses led the wilderness years but never entered; Joshua finished the journey. After 53 years, Brunson is the one who led New York across.
connection.narrative: Joshua stopped the sun to finish the battle. Brunson owns the fourth quarter.
connection.relationship: The general who ended the wandering

scripture.hebrew: הֲלוֹא צִוִּיתִיךָ חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ אַל־תַּעֲרֹץ וְאַל־תֵּחָת כִּי עִמְּךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵךְ׃
scripture.english: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of good courage; be not affrighted, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

connection.receipt: 2026 Finals MVP; scored 45 in the clinching Game 5 to end a 53-year title drought

interactions.description: Jalen Brunson and Joshua standing together as equals
